meta.title: Token saver
meta.description: Saves tokens and model steps without changing the tool set or rewriting history, so the KV-cache prefix stays stable. A: plan-first / parallel-batch guidance, a soft per-turn step budget (advisory notices at steps 12/20), and redundant re-read nudges. B: count-first grep/glob summaries, JSON/JSONL→TOON, table stride sampling, log error-line protection, and structure-aware pwsh/web_fetch compression; a never-worse gate (≤72% bytes and strictly fewer tokens), cross-turn dedupe, shadow mode, and /token-saver stats. Tune thresholds and tool profiles in the Configuration form (row id: dsh-token-saver).
